place_fields.micro_region: Vijayapura old city / north-west fort wall
place_fields.summary: Shahapur Gate is a historic gateway in the former fortified city of Bijapur, now Vijayapura. It forms the north-western gateway of the city's historic fortification and is associated with the Adil Shahi-era fort walls.

planning_attributes.description: Historic gate forming part of the former fortified walls of Bijapur/Vijayapura.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Shahapur Gate is identified as the north-western gate of Bijapur's historic fortification. Historical descriptions of the gate note defensive features including projecting iron spikes intended to resist elephant attacks.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The supplied location is at Shapur Gate, Mathapati Galli, in Vijayapura; reach Vijayapura by road or rail and continue locally to the gate.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The site is part of an old fortification; take care around uneven historic masonry and surrounding traffic.

place_fields.micro_region: Vijayapura old city / eastern fort precinct
place_fields.summary: Gol Gumbaz is the monumental tomb of Mohammed Adil Shah in Vijayapura. Its enormous unsupported dome and famous Whispering Gallery are defining features of the Adil Shahi-era complex.

planning_attributes.description: Monumental 17th-century mausoleum and historic complex dedicated to Mohammed Adil Shah.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: The dome and monument rise to roughly 60 metres overall; the dome is about 44 metres in diameter.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Gol Gumbaz is the tomb of Mohammed Adil Shah, who ruled from 1627 to 1657. The complex includes the mausoleum, mosque, Naqqar Khana and former guest-house remains; its Whispering Gallery is noted for its unusual acoustics.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Vijayapura is connected by road and rail; the nearest railway station is Vijayapura Railway Station, after which the monument can be reached locally.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use designated visitor paths and stairs carefully within the historic monument and elevated gallery areas.
planning_attributes.notes: Incredible India lists opening hours as 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM for the monument.

place_fields.summary: Ibrahim Rauza is a celebrated mausoleum-and-mosque complex in Vijayapura, built for Ibrahim Adil Shah II and associated with Taj Sultana. The complex is known for finely carved stonework, slender minarets and balanced Deccan architecture.

planning_attributes.description: Historic mausoleum and mosque complex on a high stone terrace in Vijayapura.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The complex contains the sepulcher of Ibrahim Adil Shah II and a mosque, and is regarded as one of India's finely proportioned Islamic monuments. It was built in the Adil Shahi period and is noted as an inspiration for the Taj Mahal.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Vijayapura is connected by road and rail; continue locally to Ibrahim Rauza on the western side of the city.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Remain on visitor paths and take care around steps, elevated terraces and historic stonework.
planning_attributes.notes: The Vijayapura District administration lists visiting hours as 06:00 AM to 06:00 PM.
